reviews.comment: Professor Law is great. In-class participation is needed and there is pre-class work, but not super time consuming. If you show up to class and contribute a few times you'll have no problem. He's super nice and likes to work with students to improve his class and will provide curves or extra points if he notices the class struggling with quizzes.

A super nice guy, class is time-consuming but not difficult. he is very structured and super open to criticism about his class. tbh, I never did the pre-class work, but I still maintained an A for more than half the semester. quizzes were application-based and on the more difficult side but not impossible

He's a really nice guy, but the grading criteria for the class is too difficult. From hearing other 466s, this is by far the most difficult and time-consuming. With pre-class assignments, frequent quizzes, and active participation, the class is a pain. If you love learning, take him. If you want more free time and a better grade, take someone else.
